products.name: Yamaha AEROX R
products.desc:
Elevate your streetwear setup with the QUIET Yamaha Aerox Graphic Hoodie. Designed for riders and scooter enthusiasts who appreciate precision engineering and bold style, this hoodie features a high-impact back print highlighting the iconic 2012 Yamaha Aerox R 50.

Framed by our signature QUIET gothic branding and completed with raw technical spec breakdowns—including engine power, acceleration, and top speed metrics—this piece bridges the gap between pure 2-stroke racing DNA and everyday street fashion.

    Fit: Premium streetwear fit / True to size

    Graphic Details: Large back print featuring custom Yamaha Aerox graphics, spec chart, and official-style tuning emblem

    Feel: Ultra-soft interior fleece with heavy-duty ribbed cuffs and hem for maximum warmth and structure

    Material: Cotton / Polyester blend for durable daily wear
